text:
*regarding the new 2-year visa*
Hi! 

My second A5 extension is coming up and I am hoping to get the 2-years extension in accordance with the new regulations. I am wondering how the center of life rule regarding days abroad will be applied on a two years visa. Rather 180 days for the whole period or 90-90?

It’s important for me to be informed about this subject before the appointment, since I have lots of business trips coming up in the next year and might want to address it during my appointment.

Thanks in advance!
